{{Quote|The Zann Consortium shall rule!|[[Tyber Zann]]|<ref name="FoC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>}}
The '''Zann Consortium''', known simply as the '''Consortium''', was a crime syndicate led by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tyber Zann]] which sabotaged and interfered with both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], where it amassed considerable power and wealth, becoming a major nuisance&mdash;to both the Empire and the Alliance.

The Zann Consortium became powerful after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] due to Tyber Zann's discovery of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] hidden vaults and the elimination of its main rival [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. The Zann Consortium gained most of its technology through its affiliation with the [[Black market/Legends|black market]], and its [[Defiler]]s, which were known for traveling to hostile systems and setting up illegal outposts which promoted piracy and sabotage.

==History==
===Formation===
[[File:FoC_cover.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Tyber Zann, leader of the Zann Consortium]]
The Zann Consortium was formed as a [[consortium]] before [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Led by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tyber Zann]], the crime syndicate spread corruption throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and at some point joined forces with the [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Pirates]].<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> Zann worked closely with affiliate [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and learned much from the corpulent gangster. Zann then stole a valuable [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] from Jabba, but was arrested by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and sent to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. Moments before his arrest, Zann entrusted the holocron to his partner, [[Urai Fen]]. He evaded capture and escaped the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with the artifact.

Concerned for the survival of the Zann Consortium, Urai Fen contacted allies of the Consortium on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Kamino then served as a base for a very limited time, but the Kaminoans, with few resources, could not contribute much. The Consortium then relocated to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Fen led the Consortium to victory over the Imperial forces on Ryloth, the only remaining obstacle to the group's use of the planet, and laid low until Tyber Zann was ready.

===Escape from Kessel===
{{Quote|My stay in prison has not done wonders for the Consortium.|[[Tyber Zann]]|<ref name="FoC" />}}
Zann languished in the prisons of Kessel until Jabba the Hutt, gloating at Zann's capture, released him from his cell while delivering a message broadcast via an [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6 droid]]. However, Zann was already planning his escape by engineering a prison riot and slipping out amongst the chaos. Urai Fen was already in orbit of the planet and was promptly contacted by Zann. Fen landed on the planet with help from [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].

A [[Unidentified Mustafarian bounty hunter|bounty hunter]] sent by Jabba the Hutt caught up with an unarmed Zann as he left his cell, only to be killed by Fen, who gave Zann back an upgraded version of Zann's old pistol. Tyber and Urai bribed and fought through the security checkpoints and past [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and a few [[Phase II Dark Trooper/Legends|Phase II dark troopers]], breaking other prisoners free as a distraction to aid them in his escape. The pair finally rendezvoused with an impatient Solo, and Zann left the prisoners to their fate and made his exit in the ''Millennium Falcon''. After his departure from Kessel, Tyber Zann began his campaign to restore the Consortium to power in the galaxy.

===Accumulation of power===
{{Quote|We shall do as we have always done, Urai. There are always worlds that are ripe for corruption. Through Imperial and Rebellion planets, we shall spread corruption and rebuild the Zann Consortium into a crime network that once again will be feared throughout the galaxy!|[[Tyber Zann]], to [[Urai Fen]].|<ref name="FoC" />}}
[[File:Corrupted_galaxy.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Tyber Zann views the corruption efforts over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].]]

The Palace on Ryloth was the only Consortium asset remaining to the Consortium together with a handful of mercenary soldiers. In order to announce to the galaxy that the Zann Consortium was back in business, Zann had Fen assassinate the Imperial Governor on [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]]. A racketeering operation was promptly set up on [[Shola/Legends|Shola]] followed by a series of raids on [[Mandal Hypernautics Corporation|Mandal Hypernautics]]. This gave the Consortium a modest supply of funds and ships while power was quietly built up. Zann was obsessed with gaining revenge on the Empire and heard that the Emperor stored his fortune in private vaults. Planning to rob them, Zann scouted the [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]] system once the news broke of the destruction of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], reasoning that it was standard operating procedure for personnel on Imperial stations to eject [[data pod]]s before they were destroyed. Tyber commanded a small fleet and rummaged through the remains of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] in orbit around Yavin Prime. After engaging [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces in the area commanded by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], he found a data pod containing discovered plans for the [[Eclipse-class dreadnought|''Eclipse''-class dreadnought]], which was currently under construction in the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], as well as plans for the [[Aggressor-class destroyer|''Aggressor''-class destroyer]]. Zann planned to seize the [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']], as it was going to be the Emperor's personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] (as the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] was the personal flagship of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]).

While Zann was battling both the Rebels and Imperials in the Yavin system, Jabba the Hutt struck at the Consortium on Ryloth, destroying the barracks there as well as hitting other Consortium assets across the galaxy. This prompted Zann to deal with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] threat once and for all. Consortium agents had discovered that Jabba the Hutt was coordinating his forces through a relay station on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], which was swiftly captured by Urai Fen. This pointed the Consortium in the direction of [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]], where Zann had a final showdown with Jabba inside an old [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle-droid]] factory. After shutting down the automated production lines and bribing the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] bounty hunter [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], Zann had Jabba by the throat, demanded the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head removed, the attacks on Consortium personnel and property ceased and the permanent secession of Saleucami and Hypori to the Consortium in exchange for letting him go. Jabba agreed on the provision that Hutt Space was to be left alone. The factories on Hypori would now churn out [[Droideka Mark II|second-generation Droidekas]].

The Zann Consortium continued to operate behind the scenes, establishing its presence on numerous planetary systems across the galaxy. It dealt extensively in slaves, particularly on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], some of which were used as cannon fodder during Consortium ground operations. Kidnapping of Imperial and Rebel officials was not beyond the Consortium&mdash;perhaps the most famous "victim" being [[Bevel Lemelisk]], who was abducted from [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. Zann also became embroiled in the downfall of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] leader [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], framing him for [[Ground Battle on Bespin|stealing]] [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna gas]] from [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], despite the arrival of Imperial reinforcements, including Darth Vader.

Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Tyber captured the ''Eclipse'' and [[Battle for the Eclipse|destroyed]] [[Annihilator (Executor-class)/Legends|another]] [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]]. Zann stole billions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], technical data spanning decades, and priceless works of art from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal vault network, thus ensuring that the Consortium expand to galactic levels. After his theft, Tyber decided to abandon the ''Eclipse'', as it would be a "target even the Rebels could not ignore." The ''Eclipse'' was later recovered by Imperial forces, who continued its construction. Zann also decided to let the Rebel Alliance form their [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], as he viewed its creation as an opportunity to allow him to "own a senator."

The Consortium was also intent on discovering the mysteries of [[Carbonite Sith Army holocron|the ancient Sith holocron]], stolen from Jabba while he was making a deal with the Galactic Empire on Felucia. However, [[Silri]], a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] in Zann's employ, stole the holocron during the [[Raid on the Imperial Archive|theft on Coruscant]] before they could decipher it, and unlocked its secrets. The artifact led her to an ancient Sith tomb, with thousands of [[Carbonite Sith Army|Sith soldiers]] frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].

The Zann Consortium fleet had been defeated for a number of years by the time [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s fleet emerged from the [[Maw Installation]] and initiated her series of attacks on the New Republic<ref name="Message to Spacers 8">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/Mesop8|text=Message to Spacers 8}}</ref> in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="Dark Apprentice novel">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>

===Missions===
[[File:Zann_gang.jpg|thumb|250px|Five important members of the Consortium from left to right: [[Urai Fen]], [[Tyber Zann]], a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] riding a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], [[Silri]], and [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]]]]

Only one mission before the theft of Jabba's artifact and the dissolution of the Consortium is known, but missions from that point on included:

*[[Mission to Mandalore (Zann Consortium)|Kidnapping]] the [[Supreme Strategist]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]
*Establishing and using a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]
*[[Battle of Felucia (Zann Consortium)|Stealing]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifact on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]
*Moving Consortium forces to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]
*[[Ground Battle on Kessel|Breaking]] [[Tyber Zann]] out of the prisons of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]
*[[Skirmish on Honoghr|Intimidating]] the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] on Honoghr
*Establishing [[racketeering]] on [[Shola/Legends|Shola]]
*[[Skirmish over Mandalore|Dueling]] [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|the Mandalorian Clan Leader]] above Mandalore
*[[Skirmish on Nal Hutta|Kidnapping]] Spaceport Director [[Tanda]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]
*[[Space Battle at Yavin 4|Searching]] the remnants of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] for information capsules
*Establishing and using a black market on Kuat
*[[Skirmish on Saleucami|Attacking]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Koong Eeth]] on Saleucami
*Sabotaging and [[Battle of Saleucami (Zann Consortium)|invading]] Jabba's outpost on Saleucami
*[[Ground Battle on Hypori|Invading]] the [[Hypori droid factory|droid factory]] on Hypori
*[[Ground Battle on Dathomir|Freeing]] [[Silri]] for information on the artifact
*Setting up a slave ring on Sullust for enslaving native [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]]
*Raiding tibanna gas on Bespin and blaming Xizor
*[[Space Battle at Carida|Meeting]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] above [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]
*[[Raid on the Imperial Archive|Raiding]] the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] vault on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]
*Fighting in the [[Battle for the Eclipse|Battle for the ''Eclipse'']]

==Tactics==
[[File:Star-wars-empire-at-war-forces-of-corruption-20061024035411691.jpg|thumb|Consortium forces above [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]]]
The Zann Consortium used its extensive crime network to influence the warring factions during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], siphon their credits, and sabotage their operations when necessary. It dealt in multiple illegal operations, such as establishing widespread [[racketeering]] jobs on many worlds; bribery, piracy, [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], and corrupting local militia on planets, as well as intimidating or kidnapping individuals who defied the Consortium. One particular means of income was offering military protection to planets that wanted no part in the ongoing Galactic Civil War. They also extorted money from miners. The Consortium also constructed [[Consortium palace|palaces]] on various worlds to serve as its financial centers.

With access to the black market, Zann had several unique technologies at his disposal, including [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droids]] and [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth generators]], that allowed undetected movement across the galaxy. The Zann Consortium also hired bounty hunters such as Bossk and [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]] to eliminate certain targets in order to further its influence.
